tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

# Tâche : jalon 2, passe 1 — raffinement MM-03 → MM-02 (disposition, relation de représentation, accès, allocation, cadres)

## Git
Nouvelle branche brouillon `formal/refinement_0.1`, créée depuis `formal/access_model_0.1`. Pas de merge, pas de PR. Tout sous `formal/`. `Ern/MM02.lean` et `Ern/MM03.lean` inchangés : un lemme qui leur manque est ajouté dans le nouveau module. Nouveau module `Ern/MM23.lean`, qui importe les deux.
Spécifications jointes, non copiées : `ERN_MM02_v04.md` (MM-01 et MM-02 v0.4, validées) et MM-03.3 v0.3 révisée. Elles font foi ; les deux modules existants sont des brouillons. Tout écart entre un module et son texte est rapporté, jamais corrigé silencieusement.

## Langue
Code, docstrings, commentaires, messages de commit en anglais. Rapport en français.

## Arbitrages (font foi)
K1. Disposition paramétrique. `Layout` associe à chaque feuille une plage d'octets `(allocation, offset, size)` d'une allocation MM-02 ; elle ne fixe ni ABI, ni alignement de type, ni ordre des champs. Obligations `LayoutWF` : (a) les feuilles d'un même emplacement racine sont dans la même allocation ; (b) deux feuilles distinctes ont des plages disjointes ; (c) chaque plage est incluse dans son allocation ; (d) une forme à une feuille peut avoir une taille nulle. Aucune autre hypothèse.
K2. Racines et allocations.
  - Racine locale d'un cadre ou statique ↔ allocation automatique ou statique ; son autorité de désallocation est un jeton propre au cadre, compatible par construction.
  - Racine créée par `alloc` ↔ allocation créée par `AllocStep`.
  - Partie ↔ sous-plage de l'allocation de sa racine ; bloc d'arène ↔ sous-plage de l'allocation du stockage de l'arène, sans allocation propre.
  - Le choix de la base d'une nouvelle allocation est un paramètre `Placement`, dont l'obligation est `AllocPre` de MM-02 (fraîcheur, alignement, non-chevauchement des allocations vivantes) ; `K.Satisfiable` implique l'existence d'un placement valide.
K3. Relation de représentation `Repr k L s3 s2` : `LayoutWF` ; toute racine utilisable a son allocation vivante ; toute feuille `Init` a tous ses octets initialisés dans MM-02 ; une racine morte par `free` ou par sortie de cadre a son allocation morte ; une racine morte par `endUse` (stockage possédé non libéré) garde son allocation vivante. État initial : `Repr` entre `S3.init statics` et l'état MM-02 obtenu depuis `State.empty` par les `AllocStep` des statiques, puis l'écriture des statiques déclarées `Init`.
K4. Correspondance des pas, périmètre de la passe 1 :
  - `read3` ↦ `ReadStep` sur chaque plage lue, accès de provenance = allocation de la racine, autorité `read` ;
  - `write3`, `writeShared` ↦ `WriteStep`, autorité `write` ;
  - `alloc` `ok` ↦ `AllocStep` ; `alloc` `fail` ↦ aucun pas ;
  - `free` ↦ `DeallocStep`, autorité `Compatible` issue de `FreeCompat` ;
  - `enterFrame` ↦ un `AllocStep` par racine locale ; `exitFrame` ↦ un `DeallocStep` par allocation automatique du cadre, et aucun pour le stockage possédé qui meurt avec lui (fuite si non libéré) ;
  - `derive`, `split`, `release`, `depend`, `endUse`, `pin`, `unpin`, `newArena`, `reset` ↦ aucun pas.
  `transfer`, `store` et `issue` sont hors de cette passe.
K5. Obligations opaques de MM-02 : `stat` (concurrence) est vrai dans le fragment séquentiel ; `dec` (alignement d'accès, validité de représentation) est une hypothèse paramétrique explicite, jamais instanciée par `True` sans le signaler.

## Étapes (un commit par étape)
1. K1–K3 : `Layout`, `LayoutWF`, `Placement`, `Repr`, `repr_init`.
2. R1 : `read3` `ok` et `Repr` ⇒ `ReadStep` `ok` sur chaque plage, jamais `ub`, et la valeur lue est celle des octets. R2 : `write3`, `writeShared` `ok` et `Repr` ⇒ `WriteStep` `ok`, et `Repr` préservée.
3. R6 (périmètre K4) : pour chaque opération, `ok` en MM-03 et `Repr` ⇒ la séquence MM-02 associée n'a que des issues `ok`, et les états d'arrivée sont en `Repr` ; `alloc` `fail` ⇒ aucun pas, `Repr` préservée.
4. R4 : sur un état en `Repr` avec un état atteint de MM-03, aucune autorité active ne couvre une feuille dont l'allocation MM-02 est morte (depuis `NoDangling`).
5. `exclusive_bytes` : sous `Repr` et I1, si une autorité a le mode effectif `Modify` sur une feuille, aucune autre autorité active qui n'en descend pas n'a de mode effectif sur une feuille dont la plage chevauche la sienne. Justification mémoire du non-aliasing, côté noyau seulement.
6. Cas : un témoin par opération du périmètre, depuis `S3.init`, avec l'état MM-02 en `Repr` et la séquence MM-02 exhibée.

## Hors périmètre (passes suivantes)
`transfer`, `store`, `issue` (octets de pointeur, provenance) ; `DDSound` réel depuis `LayoutWF` et `DeclaredDisjoint` ; stabilité des adresses épinglées ; concurrence ; traduction bas niveau.

## Règles
Zéro `sorry` ; `#print axioms` au plus {propext, Quot.sound} ; aucun `noncomputable` ; `lake build` sans avertissement ; docstrings citant la clause (MM-02 v0.4, MM-03.3 v0.3) ou l'arbitrage K ; rien d'inventé ; aucun énoncé affaibli ; revue adverse centrée sur `Repr` (une relation trop faible rendrait R1, R2 et R6 vides : chaque théorème doit avoir un témoin où sa conclusion n'est pas triviale) ; contre-exemples conservés.

Module commité ; `formal/reports/MM23_v0.1.md` : (a) clause → déclaration ; (b) statut de R1, R2, R4, R6 et de `exclusive_bytes` ; (c) décisions non dictées par les textes ; (d) ce qui n'est pas prouvé, et pourquoi ; (e) questions pour arbitrage ; (f) écarts entre les brouillons `MM02`/`MM03` et leurs textes, trouvés en route.

/-! ## Copies and pointers (L6: `transfer`, `store`, `issue`) -/

/-- The bytes of the range of the leaf `l` in `s2`, if its allocation is registered. -/
def rangeBytes (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Option (List MM02.AByte) :=
  (s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map fun a => a.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len

/-- L6: the bytes of the range of the leaf `l` in `s2` as the argument of a write, value and
provenance of each initialised byte ("avec les octets lus, provenance comprise"). -/
def bytesOf (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat := fun i =>
  match (s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map fun a => a.bytes ((L l).off + i) with
  | some (MM02.AByte.init v p) => (v, p)
  | _ => (0, none)

/-- L6: the pairs of corresponding leaves of `transfer src dst` (`corr`, the ordered isomorphism
of O4.2), in the order of the leaves of the source. -/
def transferPairs (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (footprint P src).filterMap fun l => (corr P src dst l).map fun l' => (l, l')

/-- L6 (`transfer`): for each pair `(l, l')`, a read of the range of `l` (`ReadStep`), then a write
of the range of `l'` (`WriteStep`) with the bytes of the range of `l`. Held authorities and owned
storage give no step. -/
def copyOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) : List (Nat × Nat) → List Op2
  | [] => []
  | (l, l') :: ps => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l) :: .write (leafAcc s2 L .write l') (bytesOf s2 L l) ::
      copyOps s2 L ps

/-- L6 (`transfer src dst`): the copy of the corresponding leaves. -/
def transferOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : List Op2 :=
  copyOps s2 L (transferPairs P src dst)

commit 579808d1102212b0856ff441d8f4324a617dfea6
Author: Guy Senpai <guy.senpai@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Oct 31 23:36:00 2026 +0100

    MM23 pass 2, step 6: cases and a full simulated execution
    
    Why: step 6 of the pass-2 brief asks for one witness per new operation and a
    full execution (allocation, arena, emission, store, transfer to the caller,
    free, frame exit) translated step by step.
    
    What:
    - CaseSim: an 18-step MM-03 execution from S3.init [] (enterFrame, write3,
      alloc, write3, newArena, two derives, pin, enterFrame of a callee, issue,
      store, transfer to the caller, exitFrame, endUse, reset, unpin, free,
      exitFrame), built as SimRun prefixes with one Params fixed for the run;
      simulation gives AllOk, the MM-02 state and Repr on every prefix.
    - Witnesses on the steps of the run: r6_issue, pointer_sound_issue (decode
      104, provenance 4), pointer_sound_store (decode 8, provenance 0),
      transfer_copies (pointer bytes copied to the caller with provenance 4),
      r6_noStep for reset, simulation_pinned across the transfer; Repr fails
      without the writes of issue or transfer.
    - L6: PtrEncOK (universal over addresses, satisfiable by no decode that
      reads finitely many bytes) becomes the per-pointer PtrEncAt; no theorem
      used PtrEncOK. pointer_sound_store and pointer_sound_issue state the L6
      obligation (decode gives base + offset of the first leaf, each byte the
      provenance of its allocation, live).
    - Decidable instances for NoOwner and LayoutObl.
    
    How proved: lake build clean, no warnings; axiom sweep: 331 theorems of
    Ern.MM23 within {propext, Quot.sound}; the 14 new examples checked the same
    way as theorems in a scratch copy; forbidden-word grep empty.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- `parent` link of the place with index `i` (MM-03.3.2). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf P p q` (MM-03.3.2, logical composition): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` itself
or one of its ancestors along `parent`. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- Structural disjointness (MM-03.3.2): neither path is a part of the other. -/
def structurallyDisjoint (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ¬ partOf P p q ∧ ¬ partOf P q p

instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (structurallyDisjoint P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

/-! ## State `S3` (MM-03.3 §1) -/

/-- Initialisation state of a leaf (MM-03.3.3). -/
inductive InitSt where
  | uninit
  | init
  | moved
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Mode of an authority (MM-03.3.4). -/
inductive Mode where
  | observe
  | modify
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Order of modes: `Observe` does not exceed `Modify` (MM-03.3.4: `Modify` allows
modifications and observations). -/
def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify

instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))

/-- Authority (MM-03.3.4: `Authority { id, mode, origin?, footprint, frame, active }`). Its
identity is its index in `A`; its footprint is a list of leaves; no `Suspended` status is
stored. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.4 is generalised by `holder` (A4): a frame or the place
whose value contains the authority. -/
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1): `storage` is the place of the administered storage;
`internal` is the authority that administers it, named by `newArena` (F1); `available` and
`issued` are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block.
The arena value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (F1), which follows
transfers (A4). The anchor of §6 is not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
structure Arena where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
`newArena` (D3). `callParams f`: the parameters given to frame `f` by `enterFrame`, a ghost record
(F6): set by `enterFrame`, never modified, read by no operation. -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  freed : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool
  arenas : List Arena

instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a`, empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Appends an authority to `A`: its identity is `s.A.length`. -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1), searched within `n` steps:
`dst` for `src`; for another part, the child, at the same position among the children ordered by
index, of the place that corresponds to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1). -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- J1, « `dst` a la même forme que `src` (sous-arbres isomorphes) »: every part of `src` has a
corresponding part of `dst` with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part
of `src`. Children are matched in index order (ordered isomorphism). -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- The holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (J1): a place, part of `src`, becomes the
corresponding part of `dst` (`corr`, `dst` itself for `src`). Applied to the holders within the
value only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5; J1): every leaf of the
destination becomes `Init`, every leaf of the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited
ones included, join those of the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority
held by a part of the source (the source included) is now held by the corresponding part of the
destination (A4, J1); every place owned by a part of the source is now owned by the corresponding
part of the destination, without moving, and its root follows (A5, J1, `RootHeld`). -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` is owned by `src` or one of its parts, directly or through other owned places,
searched within `k` steps (A5). -/
def ownedWithinF (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | k + 1, q =>
(`EffAnchorOK`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state, the whole predicate, for every held
authority; J1: the destination has the shape of the source (`SameShape`). O4.3 holds by
construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst) ∧ SameShape s.P src dst

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than the shape of the destination (J1): `TransferPre`
without its last clause (`transferPre_iff`). Used to show that a transfer is rejected by the shape
clause alone. -/
def TransferPreBase (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) ∧
  AnchorOrderHeld (transferEff s src dst)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreBase k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPreBase; infer_instance

theorem transferPre_iff {k : K} {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
    TransferPre k s src dst ↔ TransferPreBase k s src dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst := by
  unfold TransferPre TransferPreBase; simp only [and_assoc]

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of
the result place; existing dependencies are kept; propagation to containing values is computed
by `depsOf`. -/
def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }

/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6); B3: exercisable `Modify` on the result; C1: the frame
of the effective anchor is the frame of the result or an ancestor of it (`EffAnchorOK`). O5.2
(real origin of the rights or storage) is not representable: the state does not relate a value
to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4 hold by construction. -/
def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q) ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧
    EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) := by
  unfold DependPre; infer_instance

/-- `depend` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O5). -/
def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)

/-! ## F4 `store` -/

/-- Effect of `store a p` (F4; G2), the write of a reference into a value: `a` is now held by the
place `p`; `a` joins the anchors of `p`; the leaf `p`, and it only, becomes `Init` (G2). -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store a p` (F4; G2), in order: `a` active, derived (`a.origin ≠ none`), held
by the current frame; `p` usable; exercisable `Modify` on `p` (B2, `HasRight`); `a` covers no leaf
of `p` nor of its owned storage, transitively (A5, `OwnedIn`); `AnchorOrder` for the added
anchor (C1, `EffAnchorOK`): the frame of the effective anchor of `a` is the frame of `p` or one
of its ancestors. G2: `p` is a leaf, the place of a reference (MM-03.3.2, `isLeaf`); `p` holds no
active authority (overwriting an `Init` leaf without authority is allowed); in the arrival state,
`p` is still exercisable at `Modify` by the current frame (`HasRight`,
`store_keeps_target_reachable`). G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival state. No inverse
operation exists (F4). -/
def StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
  EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p)
    True) ∧
  HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) := by unfold StorePre; infer_instance

/-- `store` as a relation (F4). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/

/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1; F2). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the
administered storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions
disjoint; available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions
within the storage. Clause of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal`
on its region. F2: the storage is a place of `P`, owned by anything (a local, a static, an
allocated root, a block): the ownership clause of A10 is removed. F1: `internal` is a `Modify`
authority held by a place, the arena value, and covers exactly the footprint of the storage. -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  ar.storage < s.P.length ∧
  (∃ (y : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    y.holder = .place v) ∧
  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10; C6, aligned with `ProviderRight`): exercisable
`Modify` on the arena value, or an authority `via` exercisable at `Observe` (B2) with a present
effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with valid
dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s ar) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False ∨
  (s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
    ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination leaf; that leaf, and it only, becomes `Init` (J1, second
bullet), so the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged unless the destination is one of its
leaves (`issue_into_arena_value`; J1, third bullet: a question of the pass-8 report); the region
leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value; J1: `dst` is a leaf
(`isLeaf`) that holds no active authority. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧
  isLeaf s.P dst ∧
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
    True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; G4: `reject` when the arrival state,
where the block is held by `dst`, breaks `AnchorOrderHeld`; `ok` otherwise. A failed `issue`
creates no holding relation and has no arrival state, so G4 is not checked before `fail`. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noAnchor : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)
    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `ok` outcome of `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 ∧
      (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with
    | ok h1 h2 h3 h4 => exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, e⟩
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3 h4

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten; the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged (J1). -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-! ## Arenas in the state (D3) -/

/-- The state with the entry `i` of `arenas` replaced by `ar` (D3). -/
def arenaSet (s : S3) (i : Nat) (ar : Arena) : S3 := { s with arenas := s.arenas.set i ar }

/-- J1: the leaves of the holder `h`, if it is a place, are all `Init`. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `newArena storage internal` (D3, F1, F2, J1), in order. Kept from D3: exercisable
`Modify` on `storage`; `storage` usable. F1: `internal`, named by the caller, is active, `Modify`,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), and held by a place, the arena value; the footprint of `internal` is
the footprint of `storage`; no live arena already has `internal` as `internal`. F1 removes the
guard by place index of D3 and the kind of `internal`; F2 removes the ownership of the storage
(A10): the storage may be a local, a static, an allocated root or a block. J1: the leaves of the
arena value, the holder of `internal`, are all `Init` (`LeavesInit`). -/
def NewArenaPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true)
      False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    (∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewArenaPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newArena storage internal` (D3; F1): a new entry, the whole storage available,
nothing issued. -/
def newArenaEff (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with arenas := s.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, s.afp internal, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (D3; F1). -/
def NewArenaStep (storage internal : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre s storage internal) (newArenaEff s storage internal)

/-- `arena.issue` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the step `IssueStep` of the
recorded arena, whose new logical state is written back; a missing entry is rejected. An entry
whose `internal` is released is rejected by `IssueStatic`, which asks it active. -/
inductive IssueAt (k : K) (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    AOutcome → Prop where
  | ok {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok (arenaSet s' i ar'))
  | fail {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.fail s)
  | reject {ar : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject →
      IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject
  | none : s.arenas[i]? = none → IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the entry
exists and is live (an entry whose `internal` is released cannot be reset), and `ResetPre`. -/
def ResetAtPre (k : K) (s : S3) (i via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.arenas[i]?) (fun ar => s.Active ar.internal ∧ ResetPre k s ar via) False

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (i via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetAtPre k s i via) := by
  unfold ResetAtPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` on the entry `i` (D3): `resetEff`, the new logical state written
back. -/
def resetAtEff (s : S3) (i : Nat) : S3 :=
  match s.arenas[i]? with
  | some ar => arenaSet (resetEff s ar).1 i (resetEff s ar).2
  | none => s

/-- `arena.reset` on the entry `i` of the state as a relation (D3). -/
def ResetAtStep (k : K) (i via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetAtPre k s i via) (resetAtEff s i)

/-- Determinism of `newArena` (D3; F1). -/
theorem newArena_det {st i : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : NewArenaStep st i s o₁)
    (h₂ : NewArenaStep st i s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- Determinism of `arena.reset` on an entry of the state (D3). -/
theorem resetAt_det {k : K} {i via : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}
    (h₁ : ResetAtStep k i via s o₁) (h₂ : ResetAtStep k i via s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- Determinism of `arena.issue` on an entry of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3). -/
theorem issueAt_det {k : K} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : AOutcome}
    (h₁ : IssueAt k i via region dst s o₁) (h₂ : IssueAt k i via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  have key : ∀ {ar ar' : Arena} {o o' : IOutcome}, s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      s.arenas[i]? = some ar' → IssueStep k ar via region dst s o →
      IssueStep k ar' via region dst s o' → o = o' := by
    intro ar ar' o o' h h' hs hs'; rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact issue_det hs hs'
  cases h₁ with
  | ok ha hs => cases h₂ with
    | ok ha' hs' => cases key ha ha' hs hs'; rfl

/-- MM-02.5 : l'ordre des autorités est décidable. -/
instance (a b : Auth) : Decidable (a ≤ b) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a = .read ∨ b = .write))

/-- MM-02.3 : octet abstrait, non initialisé ou initialisé avec une valeur
d'octet sur 8 bits (`val`) et une provenance optionnelle (`prov`, identité
d'allocation). -/
inductive AByte where
  | uninit
  | init (val : UInt8) (prov : Option Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- MM-02.2 : allocation abstraite. Son identité est sa clé dans `State.allocs`.
`space` espace d'adressage, `base` adresse de base, `size` étendue, `align` alignement, `live` état
d'existence, `bytes` stockage indexé par décalage depuis `base`,
`freeAuth` jeton de désallocation : si `freeAuth = some d`, les autorités
capables de la désallouer (MM-02.2) sont les `auth` telles que
`Compatible auth d` (MM-02.D) ; `none` si la désallocation n'est pas applicable. -/
structure Alloc where
  space : Nat
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  align : Nat
  live : Bool
  bytes : Nat → AByte
  freeAuth : Option Nat

/-- MM-02.4 : emplacement, allocation (`alloc`, identité) et portion de son
stockage (`off` décalage, `len` longueur). Interprétation typée et conditions
d'accès non modélisées. -/
structure Place where
  alloc : Nat
  off : Nat
  len : Nat

/-- MM-02.5 : moyen d'accès. `addr` adresse, `prov` provenance (identité
d'allocation, sans étiquette : lecture fixée par la tâche), `len` plage,
`auth` autorité. -/
structure Access where
  addr : Nat
  prov : Nat
  len : Nat
  auth : Auth

/-- État de la machine abstraite : allocations par identité (MM-02.2) et
prochaine identité fraîche `next` (MM-02.A). -/
structure State where
  allocs : Nat → Option Alloc
  next : Nat

/-- MM-02.A : invariant de fraîcheur, toute identité utilisée est `< next`. -/
def WF (s : State) : Prop := ∀ i, s.next ≤ i → s.allocs i = none

/-- MM-02.B.2 et MM-02.C.2 : validité spatiale, la plage de l'accès est incluse
dans l'étendue de l'allocation. -/
def Spatial (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size

/-- MM-02.B.3 : les `len` octets à partir du décalage `off` sont initialisés. -/
def Alloc.InitRange (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit

/-- MM-02.B.3 : l'initialisation d'une plage est décidable (quantification bornée). -/
instance (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Decidable (a.InitRange off len) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit))

/-- MM-02.B : lecture typée permise. Conditions 1 (stockage vivant),
2 (spatial), 3 (initialisation), 5 (autorité de lecture). -/
def Read (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧
    a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth

/-- MM-02.C : écriture typée permise. Conditions 1 (stockage vivant),
2 (spatial), 3 (autorité d'écriture). -/
def CanWrite (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth

/-- MM-02.B : la validité spatiale est décidable. -/
instance (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Decidable (Spatial a ac) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size))

/-- MM-02.B : les conditions du noyau d'une lecture (`Read`) sont décidables. -/
instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (Read s ac) :=
  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a =>
    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧
        Auth.read ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb

/-- MM-02.C : les conditions du noyau d'une écriture (`CanWrite`) sont décidables. -/
instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (CanWrite s ac) :=
  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a =>
    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb

/-- MM-02.4 : résolution partielle d'un moyen d'accès vers un emplacement :
`some` exactement quand la provenance désigne une allocation existante et que la
plage de l'accès y est spatialement contenue (MM-02.B). -/
def Access.toPlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Option Place :=
  match s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a => if Spatial a ac then some ⟨ac.prov, ac.addr - a.base, ac.len⟩ else none
  | none => none

/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.4 : lecture permise formulée sur l'emplacement résolu.
Condition 2 portée par la résolution ; conditions 1, 3, 5 vérifiées séparément. -/
def ReadPlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, ac.toPlace s = some p ∧ ∃ a, s.allocs p.alloc = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧
    a.InitRange p.off p.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth

/-- MM-02.C et MM-02.4 : écriture permise formulée sur l'emplacement résolu.
Condition 2 portée par la résolution ; conditions 1, 3 vérifiées séparément. -/
def CanWritePlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, ac.toPlace s = some p ∧ ∃ a, s.allocs p.alloc = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧
    Auth.write ≤ ac.auth

/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.3 : les `len` octets de `a` à partir du décalage `off`. -/
def Alloc.bytesAt (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : List AByte :=
  (List.range len).map fun i => a.bytes (off + i)

/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.H : lecture d'octets par `ac` satisfaisant les conditions du
noyau (`Read`) ; rend les octets de la plage désignée. Ne valide pas les
obligations de lecture typée (conditions 4, 6, 7). -/
def readBytes (s : State) (ac : Access) : Option (List AByte) :=
  match s.allocs ac.prov with
  | some a => if Read s ac then some (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len) else none
  | none => none

/-- MM-02.C : effet d'une écriture sur le stockage. Les `len` octets à partir
du décalage `off` deviennent `init`, avec `w i = (valeur, provenance)` du
i-ème octet écrit ; les autres octets sont inchangés. -/
def Alloc.write (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Alloc :=
  { a with bytes := fun j =>
      if off ≤ j ∧ j < off + len then .init (w (j - off)).1 (w (j - off)).2 else a.bytes j }

/-- MM-02.C : effet d'une écriture par le moyen d'accès `ac` sur l'état. -/
def State.write (s : State) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : State :=
  { s with allocs := fun i =>
      if i = ac.prov then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w)
      else s.allocs i }

/-- MM-02.D : désallocation permise de l'allocation `id` avec l'autorité `auth` :
allocation vivante et désallouable (`freeAuth = some d`), autorité compatible
selon la relation paramétrique `Compatible`. -/
def CanDealloc (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) (s : State) (id auth : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, s.allocs id = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ ∃ d, a.freeAuth = some d ∧ Compatible auth d

/-- MM-02.D : `CanDealloc` est décidable quand la compatibilité l'est. -/
instance {Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel Compatible] (s : State) (id auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (CanDealloc Compatible s id auth) :=
  match h : s.allocs id with
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
  | some a =>
    match hf : a.freeAuth with
    | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _, d, hd, _⟩ => by
        rw [h] at hb
        cases hb
        rw [hf] at hd
        cases hd
    | some d =>
      if hc : a.live = true ∧ Compatible auth d then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc.1, d, hf, hc.2⟩
      else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hl, d', hd', hc'⟩ => hc (by
        rw [h] at hb
        cases hb
        rw [hf] at hd'
        cases hd'
        exact ⟨hl, hc'⟩)

/-- MM-02.D : effet d'une désallocation, l'allocation `id` cesse d'exister
(état mort) ; son identité reste consommée (MM-02.A). -/
def State.dealloc (s : State) (id : Nat) : State :=
  { s with allocs := fun i =>
      if i = id then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) else s.allocs i }

/-- MM-02.2 et MM-02.A : nouvelle allocation sous l'identité fraîche `s.next`,
vivante ; MM-02.3 : allocation brute nouvellement créée, octets tous `uninit`. -/
def State.alloc (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) : State :=
  { allocs := fun i =>
      if i = s.next then
        some { space, base, size, align, live := true, bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth }
      else s.allocs i
    next := s.next + 1 }

/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : les plages semi-ouvertes `[b1, b1 + n1)` et
`[b2, b2 + n2)` ont une intersection vide. -/
def RangeDisjoint (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, b1 ≤ x → x < b1 + n1 → b2 ≤ x → x < b2 + n2 → False

/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : forme arithmétique de la disjonction de deux plages
semi-ouvertes. -/
theorem rangeDisjoint_iff {b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat} :
    RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2 ↔ b1 + n1 ≤ b2 ∨ b2 + n2 ≤ b1 ∨ n1 = 0 ∨ n2 = 0 := by
  constructor

abbrev DeadAlloc (s2 : MM02.State) (i : Nat) : Prop := AllocP s2 i (·.live = false)

/-! ## Layout (K1) -/

/-- K1: layout of the leaves. The leaf `l` occupies the byte range `L l` of an MM-02 allocation:
its identity `alloc`, an offset `off` and a size `len` (an MM-02.4 place). The layout fixes no
ABI, no type alignment and no order of fields. It is a parameter of an execution, defined on
every index, present or future. -/
abbrev Layout := Nat → MM02.Place

/-- K1, obligations `LayoutWF` of a layout in an MM-03 state `s3` and an MM-02 state `s2`:
(a) the leaves of one root place are in one allocation; (b) two distinct leaves in one allocation
have disjoint ranges (`RangeDisjoint`, MM-02.2); (c) the range of every leaf lies within its
allocation, which is registered (MM-02.B, spatial containment). (d) No size is bounded below: a
range may be empty, so a shape of one leaf may have size zero. No other hypothesis. -/
structure LayoutWF (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop where
  sameAlloc : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
    ∀ l' ∈ footprint s3.P r, (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc
  disjoint : ∀ l < s3.P.length, ∀ l' < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l → isLeaf s3.P l' → l ≠ l' →
    (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc → MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len
  within : ∀ l < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l →
    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 512 in
instance (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : MM02.State) : Decidable (LayoutWF L s3 s2) :=
  decidable_of_iff
    ((∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
      ∀ l' ∈ footprint s3.P r, (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc) ∧
     (∀ l < s3.P.length, ∀ l' < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l → isLeaf s3.P l' → l ≠ l' →
      (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc → MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) ∧
     (∀ l < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l →
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-! ## Representation relation (K2, K3) -/

/-- K3: the owner `h` of a root is a frame that is no longer on the stack `F`: the root died by
the exit of its frame. -/
def FrameGone (F : Frames) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f ∉ F
  | .place _ => False

instance (F : Frames) (h : Holder) : Decidable (FrameGone F h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold FrameGone <;> infer_instance

/-- K2: deallocation token of the allocation of a root owned by `h`: the token `tok f` proper to
the frame `f` when `h` is the frame `f`; none is fixed for a root owned by a place. -/
def tokOf (tok : Nat → Nat) : Holder → Option Nat
  | .frame f => some (tok f)
  | .place _ => none

/-- K3, the decidable part of the relation of representation between an MM-03 state `s3` and an
MM-02 state `s2`, for the layout `L`, the frame tokens `tok`, the provider tokens `ptok` and the
ghost `provOf` (L4: a root allocated by `alloc` ↦ its provider):
- `lwf`: `LayoutWF` (K1);
- `inj`: two distinct root places are in distinct allocations (K2: a root corresponds to an
  allocation; a part to a sub-range of the allocation of its root, by `LayoutWF.sameAlloc`);
- `tokens`: the allocation of a root owned by the frame `f` has the token `tok f` (K2);
- `provTokens`: the allocation of a root allocated from the provider `pr` has the token `ptok pr`
  (L4);
- `live`: every usable root has its allocation live (K3);
- `init`: every `Init` leaf has all its bytes initialised (K3; L3: a `Moved` or `Uninit` leaf
  imposes nothing);
- `freed`: a root dead by `free` has its allocation dead (K3);
- `exited`: a root dead by the exit of its frame has its allocation dead (K3);
- `leaked`: a root owned by a place, not usable and not freed keeps its allocation live (K3 for a
  root dead by `endUse`; L5 for owned storage that dies with a freed root or with its frame).
It does not read the contracts `K` (L3). -/
structure ReprB (tok ptok : Nat → Nat) (provOf : Nat → Option Nat) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3)
    (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop where
  lwf : LayoutWF L s3 s2
  inj : ∀ r < s3.P.length, ∀ r' < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, ∀ l' ∈ footprint s3.P r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc
  tokens : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl =>
    OptP (tokOf tok pl.owner) (fun d => ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc (·.freeAuth = some d)) True) True
  provTokens : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (provOf r) (fun pr =>
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, AllocP s2 (L l).alloc (·.freeAuth = some (ptok pr))) True
  live : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
    LiveAlloc s2 (L l).alloc
  init : ∀ l < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →
    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len
  freed : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.freed r = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
    DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc
  exited : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl => FrameGone s3.F pl.owner)
    False → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc
  leaked : ∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → ¬ s3.Usable r → s3.freed r = false →
    OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl => pl.owner.isPlace = true) False → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
    LiveAlloc s2 (L l).alloc

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 8192 in
instance (tok ptok : Nat → Nat) (provOf : Nat → Option Nat) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3)
    (s2 : MM02.State) : Decidable (ReprB tok ptok provOf L s3 s2) :=
  decidable_of_iff
    (LayoutWF L s3 s2 ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, ∀ r' < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, ∀ l' ∈ footprint s3.P r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc) ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl =>
      OptP (tokOf tok pl.owner) (fun d => ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
        AllocP s2 (L l).alloc (·.freeAuth = some d)) True) True) ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → OptP (provOf r) (fun pr =>
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r, AllocP s2 (L l).alloc (·.freeAuth = some (ptok pr))) True) ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
      LiveAlloc s2 (L l).alloc) ∧
     (∀ l < s3.P.length, isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len) ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.freed r = true → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
      DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc) ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r →
      OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl => FrameGone s3.F pl.owner) False → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
      DeadAlloc s2 (L l).alloc) ∧
     (∀ r < s3.P.length, RootPlace s3.P r → ¬ s3.Usable r → s3.freed r = false →
      OptP (s3.P[r]?) (fun pl => pl.owner.isPlace = true) False → ∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P r,
      LiveAlloc s2 (L l).alloc))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, c', d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, c', d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, c', d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, c', d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- K3, L3: relation of representation `Repr`: `ReprB`, and the MM-02 state has fresh identities
(`MM02.WF`, MM-02.A). Not decidable (`WF` quantifies over every identity); `ReprB` is. -/
structure Repr (tok ptok : Nat → Nat) (provOf : Nat → Option Nat) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3)
    (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop extends ReprB tok ptok provOf L s3 s2 where
  wf2 : MM02.WF s2

/-! ## Sequences of MM-02 operations (MM-02.H, K4, K5) -/

/-- An MM-02 operation with its arguments (MM-02.H): read, write, deallocation, allocation. -/

/-! ## Accesses and operations attached to MM-03 steps (K4) -/

/-- K4: the access to the range of leaf `l` in `s2`: address = base of its allocation + offset,
provenance = its allocation (the allocation of its root), length = its size, authority `au`. -/
def leafAcc (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (au : MM02.Auth) (l : Nat) : MM02.Access :=
  ⟨(((s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map (·.base)).getD 0) + (L l).off, (L l).alloc, (L l).len, au⟩

/-- K4 (`read3`): one read of authority `read` per range read. -/
def readOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (ls : List Nat) : List Op2 :=
  ls.map fun l => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l)

/-- K4 (`write3`, `writeShared`): one write of authority `write` per range written, of the bytes
`w l` for leaf `l`. -/
def writeOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
    List Op2 :=
  ls.map fun l => .write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)

/-- K2, K4 (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, static storage): one allocation per root `i` of `roots`, in
order, of geometry `g i`, at the base chosen by `pl` in the current state, with the token `fa`. -/
def allocOps (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (fa : Option Nat) :
    MM02.State → List Nat → List Op2
  | _, [] => []
  | s, i :: is => .alloc (g i).space (pl s (g i)) (g i).size (g i).align fa ::
      allocOps pl g fa (s.alloc (g i).space (pl s (g i)) (g i).size (g i).align fa) is

/-- Step 6 of the task: a full execution translated step by step through `simulation`. Contracts:
leaf 0 (the metadata of the arena) `SharedMutable`; `ExternalDone` for 1; the storage 4
deallocable with the authority 7. Frame 1 has the locals 0 (arena value), 1 (allocator value), 2
(destination of the block) and 3. `alloc` gives the storage 4, parts 5 and 6, owned by 0, of root
authority 4 (L2: one root); `newArena 4 4` registers it. The caller derives 5 (`Observe` on 0) and
6 (`Modify` on 2), pins 1, and calls with `[5, 6]`; the callee has the locals 7 and 8. `issue` gives
the block 9 on the region `[5]`, held by 7; `store 5 8` writes a pointer to 0 into 8; `transfer 7 2`
moves the block to the caller; `exitFrame`; `endUse 2`; `reset`; `unpin 1`; `free 4 7`;
`exitFrame`. -/
abbrev KS : K := KT [0] [] [1] [4] [(4, 7)]
def lsC : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def lsA : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
def lsE : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) := [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def arS : Arena := ⟨4, 4, [5, 6], []⟩

def x0 : S3 := S3.init []
def x1 : S3 := enterEff x0 [] lsC
def x2 : S3 := write3Eff x1 [1]
def x3 : S3 := allocEff x2 1 0 lsA
def x4 : S3 := write3Eff x3 [0]
def x5 : S3 := newArenaEff x4 4 4
def x6 : S3 := deriveEff x5 0 0 .observe
def x7 : S3 := deriveEff x6 2 2 .modify
def x8 : S3 := pinEff x7 1 true
def x9 : S3 := enterEff x8 [5, 6] lsE
def x10 : S3 := arenaSet (issueEff x9 arS [5] 7).1 0 (issueEff x9 arS [5] 7).2
def x11 : S3 := storeEff x10 5 8
def x12 : S3 := transferEff x11 7 2
def x13 : S3 := exitEff x12
def x14 : S3 := endUseEff x13 2
def x15 : S3 := resetAtEff x14 0
def x16 : S3 := pinEff x15 1 false
def x17 : S3 := freeEff x16 4

/-- MM-02 parameters fixed once for the run (`Params`): compatibility by equality of tokens (so
`TokCompat`); frame token `100 + f`, provider token `6 + pr` (the allocator at place 1 has the
token 7); geometry of 16 bytes aligned on 8 for every root; layout: one allocation per root, leaves
of 8 bytes, the parts 5 and 6 at offsets 0 and 8 of the allocation of 4; pointers of 8 bytes, little
endian, each byte carrying the provenance; the bytes written in leaf `l` are `10 l + i`. -/
def C : Nat → Nat → Prop := fun a d => a = d
def L : Layout := fun q => match q with
  | 0 => ⟨0, 0, 8⟩ | 1 => ⟨1, 0, 8⟩ | 2 => ⟨2, 0, 8⟩ | 3 => ⟨3, 0, 8⟩
  | 4 => ⟨4, 0, 16⟩ | 5 => ⟨4, 0, 8⟩ | 6 => ⟨4, 8, 8⟩ | 7 => ⟨5, 0, 8⟩
  | 8 => ⟨6, 0, 8⟩ | _ => ⟨99, 0, 0⟩
def pe : PtrEnc :=
  ⟨fun addr prov i => ((addr >>> (8 * i)).toUInt8, prov),
   fun f => (List.range 8).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((f i).1.toNat <<< (8 * i))) 0⟩
def w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat := fun l i => ((10 * l + i).toUInt8, none)
def π : Params :=
  ⟨L, fun f => 100 + f, fun pr => 6 + pr, topPlacement, fun _ => ⟨0, 16, 8⟩, pe, w⟩
/-- Test obligations (K5): `dec`, an access aligned on 4 bytes; `stat`, true. -/
def obR : MM02.ReadOblSpec := ⟨fun _ ac => ac.addr % 4 = 0, fun _ _ => True⟩
def obW : MM02.WriteOblSpec := ⟨fun _ ac _ => ac.addr % 4 = 0, fun _ _ _ => True⟩
instance : ∀ s o, Decidable (Op2.Dec obR obW s o) := fun s o => by
  cases o <;> simp only [Op2.Dec, obR, obW] <;> infer_instance

/-- The MM-02 states of the translation: the run of `repr_init` (no static), then the sequence
associated with each step (`assoc`); the steps without MM-02 operation keep the state. -/
def n0 : MM02.State := exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π [])

theorem Exec3.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ops : List Op3} {s : S3}
    (h : Exec3 k statics ops s) : Reachable k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs ih => exact Reachable.ofStep ih hs.step

/-- Parameters of the refinement fixed once for a whole execution (step 5): the layout, the frame
and provider tokens (K2, L4), the placement (K2), the geometry of the allocation of each root place,
read on its index, the encoding of pointers (L6), the initial bytes of the statics (K3). -/
structure Params where
  L : Layout
  tok : Nat → Nat
  ptok : Nat → Nat
  pl : Placement
  geom : Nat → Geom
  pe : PtrEnc
  w0 : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat

/-- K4, L6: the MM-02 sequence associated with an MM-03 operation from the states `s3`, `s2`. -/
def assoc (π : Params) : Op3 → S3 → MM02.State → List Op2
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L w ls
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps s2 π.L s3.P src dst
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L s3 a p
  | .issue _ _ region dst, _, s2 => issueOps π.pe s2 π.L region dst
  | .alloc pr _ ls, s3, s2 =>
    allocOps π.pl (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (some (π.ptok pr)) s2 (rootIdx ls)
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 =>
    allocOps π.pl (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (some (π.tok s3.nF)) s2 (rootIdx ls)
  | .free p auth, s3, _ => deallocOps [rootAlloc π.L s3.P p] auth
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.tok s3
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- L4: the ghost `provOf` after an operation: `alloc pr _ ls` maps the places it creates to the
provider `pr`; no other operation changes it. -/
def provStep : Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → Nat → Option Nat
  | .alloc pr _ ls, s3, pv => fun r =>
    if s3.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s3.P.length + ls.length then some pr else pv r
  | _, _, pv => pv

/-- K3: the MM-02 operations of the initial state with the parameters `π`. -/
def initOpsOf (π : Params) (statics : Statics) : List Op2 :=
  initOps π.pl π.geom π.tok π.L π.w0 statics

/-- The lock-step translation of an MM-03 execution: the operations (most recent first), the MM-03
state, the ghost `provOf`, the MM-02 operations (in the order of execution) and the MM-02 state.
It starts with the MM-02 run of `repr_init`; each MM-03 step appends its associated sequence. It is
determined by the execution and the parameters. -/
inductive Trans (k : K) (statics : Statics) (π : Params) :
    List Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → List Op2 → MM02.State → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) →
      Trans k statics π [] (S3.init statics) (fun _ => none) (initOpsOf π statics)
        (exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
      {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3} :
      Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → Step3 k op s3 s3' →
      Trans k statics π (op :: ops) s3' (provStep op s3 pv) (os ++ assoc π op s3 s2)
        (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2))

/-- Every MM-03 execution has a translation. -/
theorem Trans.of_exec {k : K} {statics : Statics} (π : Params) {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    (h : Exec3 k statics ops s3) : ∃ pv os s2, Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact ⟨_, _, _, .init hsh⟩
  | step _ hs ih => obtain ⟨pv, os, s2, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, _, _, ht.step hs⟩

/-- K1, K2: the layout obligation of an operation that creates root places: the new roots are laid
out in fresh allocations, within their geometry (`NewLayout`). -/
def LayoutObl (π : Params) : Op3 → S3 → S3 → MM02.State → Prop
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s3', s2 =>
    NewLayout π.L s3'.P s3.P.length s2.next (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (rootIdx ls)
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s3', s2 =>
    NewLayout π.L s3'.P s3.P.length s2.next (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (rootIdx ls)
  | _, _, _, _ => True

instance (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3) (s2 : MM02.State) :
    Decidable (LayoutObl π op s3 s3' s2) := by
  cases op <;> unfold LayoutObl <;> infer_instance

theorem ReprB.provOf_congr {tok ptok : Nat → Nat} {pv pv' : Nat → Option Nat} {L : Layout}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} (hR : ReprB tok ptok pv L s3 s2)
    (h : ∀ r < s3.P.length, pv' r = pv r) : ReprB tok ptok pv' L s3 s2 :=
  { hR with provTokens := fun r hr hrt => by rw [h r hr]; exact hR.provTokens r hr hrt }

theorem decAlong_readOps {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec} {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {s2 s2' : MM02.State}
    {L : Layout} : ∀ {ls : List Nat}, DecAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2' L ls) →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2' L .read l)
  | [], _, _, h => by cases h
  | _ :: _, ⟨h0, h⟩, _, hl => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl with rfl | hl
    · exact h0
    · exact decAlong_readOps h _ hl

/-- L4: the obligation of the contracts at a `free` of the run: `FreeCompat` is instantiated by
the token of the provider recorded by the ghost `provOf` (`FreeCompatInst`). -/
def FreeOblig (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params) : Op3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → Prop
  | .free p auth, pv => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.ptok pv p auth
  | _, _ => True

/-- The obligations of one step of the run, on the states where it runs: the layout of the new
roots (`LayoutObl`, K1, K2), `dec` along its MM-02 sequence (K5), and `FreeOblig` (L4). -/
def Oblig (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec)
    (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3) (pv : Nat → Option Nat) (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop :=
  LayoutObl π op s3 s3' s2 ∧ DecAlong ObR ObW s2 (assoc π op s3 s2) ∧ FreeOblig k C π op pv

/-- An execution of MM-03 with its translation (`Trans`) whose every step meets its obligations
(`Oblig`), and whose initial run meets the layout of the statics and `dec`. The obligations bear on
the states of this execution and its run only. -/
inductive SimRun (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec)
    (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) (statics : Statics) (π : Params) :
    List Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → List Op2 → MM02.State → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      DecAlong ObR ObW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics) →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π [] (S3.init statics) (fun _ => none) (initOpsOf π statics)
        (exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
      {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3} :
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → Step3 k op s3 s3' →
      Oblig k C ObR ObW π op s3 s3' pv s2 →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (op :: ops) s3' (provStep op s3 pv) (os ++ assoc π op s3 s2)
        (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2))

/-- A `SimRun` is the canonical translation of its execution. -/
theorem SimRun.trans {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State}
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) : Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh _ _ => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact ih.step hs

/-- A `SimRun` is an execution of MM-03. -/
theorem SimRun.exec3 {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State}
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) : Exec3 k statics ops s3 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh _ _ => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact ih.step hs

/-- `simulation` (step 5): along every execution of MM-03 from `S3.init statics` within the
envelope of L1 and L2, translated with parameters `π` fixed once for the whole execution, whose
steps meet their obligations (`SimRun`), the MM-02 run starts with the run of `repr_init`, appends
at each step the sequence associated by K4 and L6, has only `ok` outcomes, reaches the state `s2`,
and is in `Repr` with the MM-03 state; the MM-03 state is reached, and the ghost `provOf` is empty
beyond the places. Since every prefix of a `SimRun` is a `SimRun`, this holds at each step. The
remaining hypotheses: `DDSound k` (L7: `ddSound_of_layout`); `stat` (K5); the obligation of the
placement and valid alignments (K2); the compatibility of the frame tokens (K2). -/
theorem simulation {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec} {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec}
    {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstatR : ∀ s ac, ObR.stat s ac) (hstatW : ∀ s ac w, ObW.stat s ac w)
    (hpl : PlacementOK π.pl) (hg : ∀ r, 0 < (π.geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 (π.geom r).align)
    (htc : TokCompat C π.tok) :
    ∀ {ops s3 pv os s2}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 →
      AllOk C ObR ObW MM02.State.empty os ∧ exec MM02.State.empty os = s2 ∧
      Repr π.tok π.ptok pv π.L s3 s2 ∧ Reachable k statics s3 ∧
      ∀ r, s3.P.length ≤ r → pv r = none := by
  intro ops s3 pv os s2 ht
  induction ht with
  | init hsh hlay0 hdec0 =>
    have := repr_init (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (tok := π.tok) (ptok := π.ptok)
      (provOf := fun _ => none) hsh hpl (fun i _ => hg i) hlay0 (fun _ _ => rfl) hstatW hdec0
    exact ⟨this.1, rfl, this.2, .init hsh, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  | @step ops s3 s3' pv os s2 op _ hs hob ih =>
    obtain ⟨hok, hex, hR, hr, hpv⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hly, hdc, hfc⟩ := hob
    have hwf := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1
    have hnd := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).2.1.nd
    have hfl := (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).1
    have hfo := (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).2
    have hr' : Reachable k statics s3' := Reachable.ofStep hr hs.step
    -- the MM-02 side of the step
    have key : AllOk C ObR ObW s2 (assoc π op s3 s2) ∧
        Repr π.tok π.ptok (provStep op s3 pv) π.L s3' (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2)) := by
      cases op with
      | derive => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.derive hs)
      | split => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.split hs)
      | release => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.release hs)
